proves.claim: with 300 writes pending in one queue directory, a drain applies them in publish order, parses each pending record once rather than once per pass, still drops a pending record whose owner process is gone or whose result is stored, and the case prints the drain total in milliseconds.

store.io-write-queue-file.drain-reads-ea.why: Without it a drain that went back to re-reading and re-parsing every pending record after each pass would cost about 45,000 parses for 300 writes, and nothing would show it.
